verdict.rationale: CrewAI's documented memory system uses adaptive-depth recall with composite scoring (semantic similarity, recency, importance) which implicitly limits what history is surfaced to an agent, but there is no explicit documentation of trimming, summarizing, or filtering conversation history specifically to stay within a context window. Missing for 10: explicit context-window management/truncation controls, summarization utilities for long histories, and any developer-facing API for pruning conversation history.
